# Independent common-region witness

The authored circuit uses ngspice's XSPICE sidiode with no smoothing or
finite current limits. Those regions have the same piecewise-linear law
as the LTspice idealized diode. The finite-limit and smooth-region laws
are not assumed equivalent.

Regenerate with:

```sh
ngspice -n -b common.cir | awk '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && NF==3 { printf "%s\t%.17g\n",$2,-$3 }' > common.tsv
```

Columns: applied anode-to-cathode voltage (V), terminal current (A).
The minus sign converts source current to diode current.

## LTspice 24.0.12 synthetic witnesses

Generated using independently authored circuits and LTspice batch mode,
with double-precision raw output (`.options numdgt=15 plotwinsize=0`).
The raw values are retained without rounding to printed display precision.
All rows are tab-separated, no headers; empty instance field is intentional.

- `floor-witness.tsv`: case, model parameters, instance parameters,
  terminal voltage, terminal current. Voltage-source sweep -4 to 4 V
  in 0.5 V increments, Gmin=1e-12, RELTOL=1e-10, ABSTOL=1e-24.
- `ac-witness.tsv`: case, DC voltage, instance parameters, model parameters,
  Gmin, real terminal differential conductance. Unit-amplitude AC voltage
  source; `.ac lin 3 1k 1meg`.
- `noise-witness.tsv`: case, DC current, model parameters, instance parameters,
  Gmin, ambient temperature (C), OP voltage, frequency (Hz), AC gain (ohm),
  thermal, shot, flicker, total output noise and input-referred noise
  amplitudes. Unit-amplitude current source injects into the diode anode;
  `.noise V(a) I1 lin 3 1k 1meg`. The amplitudes are in V/sqrt(Hz)
  for output and A/sqrt(Hz) for input. These are measurements, not values
  generated by the Rust equations under test.

To regenerate, construct each circuit from its case parameters with
`.model dm D(...)` (not the native explicit family token), select the
listed source, analysis and options, then run LTspice in batch mode and
read its raw binary variables by name. The Rust integration test uses the
same circuits with only the model-family token and noise summary selection
changed.
